steps.caption: Option 6A · Quick open. ⌘K finds any page by its name.
Recent pages first, with type and project, then commands with their keys.
Three letters: Pricing notes, Priya Nair, the pricing task, then “New page ‘pri’”.
Aliases count: “tis” finds Thinking in Systems.
Shift-Enter opens the page beside; ⌘-Enter opens a new tab; Enter opens in place.
Titles only, and fast. Nothing else in the app moves.
